sources.title: Conscious sedation and analgesia for oocyte retrieval during in vitro fertilisation procedures (Pain relief for women undergoing oocyte retrieval for assisted reproduction)
sources.claim: 21 randomized trials, 2,974 women; no single method shown best; combining methods gave better pain relief than one alone; no significant difference in pregnancy rates across 12 studies; high satisfaction with all approaches.
sources.quote: 21 randomised controlled trials ... 2974 women ... did not support one particular method or technique over another ... resulted in better pain relief than one modality alone ... High levels of women's satisfaction were reported

sources.title: IVF oocyte retrieval: prospective evaluation of the type of anesthesia on live birth rate, pain, and patient satisfaction
sources.journal: Journal of Assisted Reproduction and Genetics
sources.claim: 481 women chose paracervical block (234) or general anesthesia (247); live birth 20.9% vs 19.8%; at 4 hours, abdominal pain 3.80 vs 3.00 and vaginal pain 2.26 vs 1.66 (0-10); satisfaction higher with general anesthesia (98.4% vs 80.8% very/somewhat satisfied); choice should be the patient's.
sources.quote: live birth rate ... 20.9% PCB vs 19.8% GA (P = 0.764) ... abdominal pain (3.80 vs. 3.00) ... the choice of anesthesia should be made by the patient

sources.title: Perioperative and post-operative complications of transvaginal ultrasound-guided oocyte retrieval: prospective study of >1000 oocyte retrievals
sources.claim: 1,058 retrievals analysed: no sedation complications; vaginal bleeding 2.8%; no pelvic infection; 3% severe pain after the procedure; pain increased with number of oocytes; about 0.7% hospitalized for pain; OR is a safe procedure.
sources.quote: vaginal bleeding in 2.8% ... no pelvic infection ... 3% severe to very severe pain ... pain increased with the number of oocytes retrieved ... Patients can be reassured that overall OR is a safe procedure

sources.title: Randomized controlled study on the use of virtual reality for pain relief in oocyte retrieval under transvaginal ultrasound guidance using paracervical block and conscious sedation
sources.claim: 160 women under paracervical block plus conscious sedation; worst pain during retrieval about 56-60 on a 100-point scale; VR did not reduce pain.
sources.quote: during oocyte retrieval (56.4 ± 24.6 vs. 60.3 ± 26.8, P = 0.34) ... The use of VR did not reduce pain levels during oocyte retrieval using paracervical block and conscious sedation

sources.title: P-597 Pain intensity of oocyte retrieval of low and moderate number of oocytes is only mild, questioning the need of anesthesia and analgesia
sources.claim: 1,039 patients, 2,290 natural or minimal-stimulation cycles without anesthesia: median pain 3.0 of 10; pain rose by 1.14 points when 6 or more eggs were aspirated vs 1; with one or few follicles retrieval can be offered without anesthesia.
sources.quote: median VAS 3.0 (IQR 2-4) ... 1.14 points with 6 or more ... In case of one or few follicles OPU can be offered without anesthesia and analgesia

sources.title: P-772 Anesthesiologist-guided general anesthesia vs. propofol sedation for oocyte retrieval: a prospective study on patient experience and clinical outcomes
sources.claim: 100 first-time patients; pain reported by 6% with anesthesiologist-guided anesthesia vs 40% with nurse-guided propofol sedation; satisfaction slightly higher with anesthesia; egg numbers similar (10.8 vs 11.4).
sources.quote: pain was reported less frequently in the anesthesia group (6% vs. 40%, p < 0.005) ... Nurse-guided propofol sedation for oocyte retrieval is feasible

sources.title: Comparison of complication rates after transvaginal ultrasound-guided oocyte pick-up procedures with respect to ovarian response
sources.claim: 789 retrievals; severe pain was the most common complication; complications 2.87% in poor, 6.39% in normal and 10.51% in high responders; high responders had about 7 times the odds of poor responders.
sources.quote: higher risk of complications, particularly severe pain, in patients with high ovarian reserve

sources.title: SART Fertility Experts - Egg Retrieval: What is it REALLY like?
sources.claim: Deep sedation: breathing on your own, no feeling or memory; aspiration takes about 10 minutes; soreness and bloating often worst the next day; infection, bleeding and anesthesia risks about 1% or less; usually acetaminophen afterwards.
sources.quote: She's breathing on her own, but she doesn't feel anything or remember anything ... maybe 10 minutes ... the day after the procedure is actually the soreness and the bloating ... pretty much 1% or less

sources.title: In Vitro Fertilization (IVF): What are the risks?
sources.claim: Pelvic infections after retrieval are uncommon; serious OHSS complications occur in less than 1% of IVF cases; most OHSS symptoms resolve within a few days.
sources.quote: Pelvic infections following egg retrieval or embryo transfer are uncommon ... Very rarely (in less than 1% of IVF cases), OHSS can lead to blood clots and kidney failure
